exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 The Animal Shelter Ad
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Jessie
transcript.text: Susan, did you see the animal shelter advertisement? It would be great for our volunteer project.

transcript.speaker: Susan
transcript.text: Yes, I did. I'd love to help out in a shelter. Think of all those cute little animals!

transcript.speaker: Jessie
transcript.text: Exactly. But maybe it's too good to be true. What if we have to clean the smelly cages?

transcript.speaker: Susan
transcript.text: I'd hate that. Can we ask for gloves?

transcript.speaker: Jessie
transcript.text: Of course. How about you clean the outside of the cages, and I'll clean the inside?

transcript.speaker: Susan
transcript.text: Thanks, Jessie, you're a true friend. By the way, when do they need us?

transcript.speaker: Jessie
transcript.text: On Sunday mornings, not Saturdays. So let's not just talk about it — let's do it!

exercises.translation_cn: Jessie 提到动物收容所的广告,觉得适合做志愿项目;Susan 愿意去帮忙,喜欢小动物;两人担心要清理脏笼子,决定要手套、并分工(一人擦外、一人擦里);时间是周日上午;两人决定行动起来。

questions.stem: What volunteer project are the girls talking about?
options: Helping out at an animal shelter.

questions.stem: What are they worried about having to do?
What does Jessie suggest asking for?
How do they decide to divide the work?
options: One cleans outside, the other inside.
They will not clean at all.

questions.stem: When does the shelter need them?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 What Volunteering Teaches Us
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many young people think that volunteering is only about giving to others.
But those who do it often say that they gain just as much in return.
Helping people who have less teaches us to be grateful for what we have.
It also gives our own lives a deeper sense of purpose.
In the end, when we share with others, we help ourselves to grow as well.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多年轻人以为志愿服务只是付出;但参与者常说自己得到的同样多;帮助拥有更少的人,教会我们对所拥有的心怀感恩;它也让我们的生活更有目标感;最终,当我们与人分享时,我们自己也在成长。

questions.stem: What do many young people think volunteering is about?
What do volunteers often say they gain?
What does helping those with less teach us?
options: To be grateful for what we have.

questions.stem: What else does volunteering give our lives?
What happens when we share with others?
options: We help ourselves to grow too.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Deciding What to Donate
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: Our class wants to donate something to the poor children in the countryside. What do you think we should give?

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: I think books would be best. Many of them have nothing to read at home.

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: That's a good idea. But some people want to give money instead.

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: Money is useful too, but it is hard to be sure how it is spent.

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: True. Maybe we could give both books and some warm clothes.

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: Perfect. And we could spend a day there, reading with the children.

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: Yes! Giving our time may matter even more than giving things.

exercises.translation_cn: 刘和梅讨论给乡村贫困儿童捐什么;梅认为捐书最好,因为很多孩子家里没书读;有人想捐钱,但梅说钱难以确定用途;两人决定既捐书也捐保暖衣物;还打算去那里陪孩子读书;刘说付出时间也许比捐物更重要。

questions.stem: What does Mei think is the best thing to donate?
Why is Mei unsure about giving money?
options: It is hard to be sure how it is spent.

questions.stem: What do they finally decide to give?
What else do they plan to do at the village?
What does Liu say may matter even more than giving things?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Sharing Instead of Wasting
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Every day, a huge amount of good food is thrown away in our cities.
Some young people have decided to do something about this waste.
They collect food that shops can no longer sell and hand it out to families in need.
In this simple way, food that would be wasted is shared with hungry people.
Sharing what we have, they say, is much better than throwing it away.
exercises.translation_cn: 城市里每天都有大量好食物被扔掉;一些年轻人决定为此做点事;他们收集商店卖不出去的食物,分发给有需要的家庭;通过这种简单的方式,本会被浪费的食物被分享给饥饿的人;他们说,分享所有比扔掉好得多。

questions.stem: What problem does the passage describe?
options: Too few shops in the city.

questions.stem: Who decided to act on this problem?
What do they do with the food they collect?
options: They throw it into the sea.
They hand it out to families in need.

questions.stem: What happens to food that would be wasted?
options: It is shared with hungry people.

questions.stem: What do these young people believe?
options: Sharing is better than throwing food away.
Food should never be given away.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Call to a Volunteer Abroad
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: Hi, dear. How is your volunteer teaching going so far?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: It's hard, Mum. There's no electricity here, and the children have only pencils and paper.

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: That sounds tough. Are you managing all right?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I am, slowly. I've had to be more imaginative and less rigid about the rules.

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: I'm proud of you. Do you feel you are making a difference?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: At first I wasn't sure. But the children love to learn, and that keeps me going.

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: Then it's worth it. By the way, your parcel of sweets is on its way!

exercises.translation_cn: 妈妈打电话问 Tom 海外支教的情况;Tom 说很辛苦,没有电,孩子们只有铅笔和纸;他在慢慢适应,变得更有创意、不那么死板;妈妈为他自豪,问他是否觉得有意义;Tom 起初不确定,但孩子们爱学习让他坚持下去;妈妈说那就值得,并告诉他寄的糖果包裹在路上了。

questions.stem: Where is Tom and what is he doing?
options: Teaching as a volunteer far from home.

questions.stem: What is one difficulty Tom mentions?
options: The children have too many books.

questions.stem: How has Tom had to change his teaching?
options: By being more imaginative and less rigid.

questions.stem: What keeps Tom going?
What does his mum say is on its way?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Thank-You Message
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: On behalf of all the children here, I would like to thank our visitors.
You came a long way to spend time with us and to lend a hand.
The books and warm clothes you brought will help us through the winter.
But more than the gifts, we are grateful for your kindness and your smiles.
We hope that one day we, too, can pay it forward and help someone else.
exercises.translation_cn: 代表这里所有的孩子,我要感谢来访的客人;你们远道而来陪伴我们、伸出援手;你们带来的书和暖衣将帮我们度过冬天;但比起礼物,我们更感激你们的善意和笑容;我们希望有一天自己也能把善意传递下去,去帮助别人。

questions.stem: Who is the speaker thanking?
options: The visitors who came to help.

questions.stem: What did the visitors come to do?
options: To spend time and lend a hand.
To take photos for a paper.

questions.stem: What will the books and clothes help with?
What are the children most grateful for?
What do the children hope to do one day?
options: Pay it forward and help someone else.
